help.l9: Bosses sail in on waves 4, 8 and 10. Golden elites have 3x HP and pay 5x gold.
help.c1: 1-6 - buy tower, then click the map to place it
help.c2: Click a tower - upgrade or sell it  |  Q - tower ability
help.c3: SPACE - pause  |  ESC - menu (Music / Sound Effects / Fullscreen)
help.c4: M - music on/off  |  F - speed 1x/3x  |  F11 - fullscreen / window
help.c5: S - sell selected  |  C - filter towers by type  |  R - show ranges
help.role.wood: Cheap and fast to field - the backbone early on.
help.role.metal: Piercing shots punch through to the next enemy; Barrage volleys the pack.
help.role.gold: Solid damage; its kills are your economy engine.
help.role.blaze: The heavy hitter for bosses and late waves.
help.tower_note: Prices scale with difficulty (EASY -20%, HARD +25%). DPS = damage x 1.67 shots/s. A LINK needs two towers of the SAME type side by side. Upgrading early is usually better than a second weak tower - but a link pair can beat both.
help.e1: Beat wave 20 and the victory screen offers ENDLESS MODE - the run continues as long as you survive.
help.e2: Endless waves grow forever: more enemies, and the mix shifts to tougher types (fewer Forkmen, more Ogres and Evil Villagers). HP starts at 5x and grows +5% every wave.
help.e3: Clearing an endless wave pays a gold bonus that grows with the wave number.
help.e4: The pirate ship bombards 2 towers on waves 4 and 8 (if you are doing well) - and 1 tower on EVERY endless wave.
help.e5: Rain means +15% gold from kills. Storm Caller doubles storm chance; a Tesla Coil guarantees a storm next round.
help.e6: In endless, the pause menu (ESC) has a wave-jump field: jump ahead - or back, even to wave 1. Wave 20 itself hides an easter egg...
help.e7: Selling refunds 80% (EASY) / 70% (NORMAL) / 60% (HARD) of everything you spent on the tower.
help.nav: Arrows or A/D: page {a}/{b} - ESC or click: back
help.role.ice: Every hit slows enemies hard; Frost Nova freezes a whole pack.
upg.treasury.desc2: Level 2: +50% gold from all kills in total.
upg.bounty.desc2: Level 2: bosses and elites give +100% gold in total.
upg.lucky.desc2: Level 2: 20% chance to deal 2x critical damage.
upg.docks.desc2: Level 2: enemies move 30% slower on the pier.
upg.storm.desc2: Level 2: storms give +40% gold. Storm Caller lightning is stronger and strikes more often.
upg.ammo.desc2: Level 2: all towers shoot 30% faster in total.
upg.drones.desc2: Level 2: heals +1 life every wave; the repair drone works faster.
upg.tesla.desc2: Level 2: stronger zaps (130, storms 160) and longer range.
upg.facility.desc2: Level 2: drone rearms in 2 min; minigun +50%, kamikaze 600 dmg.
upg.cavalry.desc2: Level 2: the ally's mortars deal +50% damage.
upg.medic.desc2: Level 2: bombardment destroys towers only 12.5% of the time.
upg.scout.desc2: Level 2: ambush +50% damage in the first 6s after spawning.
upg.supply.desc2: Level 2: towers cost 25% less in total.
upg.drums.desc2: Level 2: tower abilities recharge 50% faster in total.
upg.signal.desc2: Level 2: Bonnie's arrows set enemies on fire, Clyde's arrows poison them.
upg.guerrilla.desc2: Level 2: +60% damage against slowed enemies in total.
upg.banner.desc2: Level 2: all towers deal +20% damage in total.
upg.spikes.desc2: Level 2: spikes deal +50% damage; their poison is stronger and lasts longer.
upg.sabotage.desc2: Level 2: all enemies spawn with -25% HP in total.
help.e8: Fantasy weather can appear on any wave: Blood Moon (faster enemies, stronger towers), Ghostly Fog (+25% gold), Aurora (abilities recharge faster), Meteor Shower, Golden Wind (+3 gold per kill).
